instruction:
Gym And Support Spaces Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm in the task output folder.

Create 1 building story, 5 spaces and 5 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Gym, Lobby, Office, Restroom and Storage. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area.

Model the enclosure with 34 total OS:Surface objects, split into 5 floor surfaces, 5 roof/ceiling surfaces and 24 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 5 Ground, 13 Outdoors and 16 Surface.

Add 6 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 34.56 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 5 ideal-loads air systems, 5 zone HVAC equipment lists and 5 dual-setpoint thermostats.

Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 18.00 m in X, 10.00 m in Y and 4.00 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 180.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 224.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
